verdicts.reason: A is broken. The geometric background stops partway down the portrait canvas, which leaves big white bands at the top and bottom. The white outline frame is out of position: its top edge sits up in the empty white band and its bottom edge cuts through the pattern. The text card is pushed up toward the top, so the whole thing looks badly assembled. B is the original shrunk and letterboxed rather than rearranged. Its card, frame and pattern still hold together and the text is readable, but it has the same dead white bands top and bottom and does nothing to adapt to the taller format.
